import{runDijkstra}from'./Dijkstra';/**
 * Exact TSP using Brute Force
 * Tries all possible permutations of patients to find the optimal route
 * Complexity: O(n!)
 */export const exactTSP=(graph,startNode,patients,hospitals)=>{const startTime=performance.now();let nodesExplored=0;let bestRoute=[];let bestTotalDistance=Infinity;let bestTotalTime=Infinity;// Helper function to generate all permutations
const permute=arr=>{if(arr.length<=1)return[arr];const result=[];for(let i=0;i<arr.length;i++){const current=arr[i];const remaining=arr.slice(0,i).concat(arr.slice(i+1));const remainingPerms=permute(remaining);for(const perm of remainingPerms){result.push([current,...perm]);}}return result;};// Generate all possible patient orderings
const patientPermutations=permute(patients);nodesExplored=patientPermutations.length;// For each permutation, calculate the total route cost
for(const patientOrder of patientPermutations){// Build complete route: start -> patients in order -> best hospital
let currentTotalDistance=0;let currentTotalTime=0;let currentLocation=startNode;// Path through patients
for(const patient of patientOrder){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,patient);currentTotalDistance+=result.totalDistance;currentTotalTime+=result.totalTime;currentLocation=patient;}// Find best hospital to end at
let bestHospitalDistance=Infinity;let bestHospitalTime=Infinity;let bestHospital=hospitals[0];for(const hospital of hospitals){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,hospital);if(result.totalTime<bestHospitalTime){bestHospitalTime=result.totalTime;bestHospitalDistance=result.totalDistance;bestHospital=hospital;}}currentTotalDistance+=bestHospitalDistance;currentTotalTime+=bestHospitalTime;// Update best route if this is better
if(currentTotalTime<bestTotalTime){bestTotalTime=currentTotalTime;bestTotalDistance=currentTotalDistance;bestRoute=[startNode,...patientOrder,bestHospital];}}const endTime=performance.now();return{route:bestRoute,totalDistance:bestTotalDistance,totalTime:bestTotalTime,executionTime:endTime-startTime,nodesExplored,algorithm:'exact'};};/**
 * Nearest Neighbor TSP (Approximation)
 * Greedy approach: always visit the nearest unvisited patient
 * Complexity: O(n²)
 */export const nearestNeighborTSP=(graph,startNode,patients,hospitals)=>{const startTime=performance.now();let nodesExplored=0;const route=[startNode];let totalDistance=0;let totalTime=0;let currentLocation=startNode;const unvisitedPatients=[...patients];// Visit patients one by one, always choosing the nearest
while(unvisitedPatients.length>0){let nearestPatient=unvisitedPatients[0];let nearestDistance=Infinity;let nearestTime=Infinity;for(const patient of unvisitedPatients){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,patient);nodesExplored++;if(result.totalTime<nearestTime){nearestTime=result.totalTime;nearestDistance=result.totalDistance;nearestPatient=patient;}}totalDistance+=nearestDistance;totalTime+=nearestTime;route.push(nearestPatient);currentLocation=nearestPatient;// Remove visited patient
const index=unvisitedPatients.indexOf(nearestPatient);unvisitedPatients.splice(index,1);}// Find best hospital to end at
let bestHospital=hospitals[0];let bestHospitalDistance=Infinity;let bestHospitalTime=Infinity;for(const hospital of hospitals){const result=runDijkstra(graph,currentLocation,hospital);nodesExplored++;if(result.totalTime<bestHospitalTime){bestHospitalTime=result.totalTime;bestHospitalDistance=result.totalDistance;bestHospital=hospital;}}totalDistance+=bestHospitalDistance;totalTime+=bestHospitalTime;route.push(bestHospital);const endTime=performance.now();return{route,totalDistance,totalTime,executionTime:endTime-startTime,nodesExplored,algorithm:'nearest-neighbor'};};/**
 * Compare exact and approximate TSP solutions
 */export const compareTSP=(exact,approximate)=>{const distanceDifference=approximate.totalDistance-exact.totalDistance;const timeDifference=approximate.totalTime-exact.totalTime;const distanceError=exact.totalDistance>0?distanceDifference/exact.totalDistance*100:0;const timeError=exact.totalTime>0?timeDifference/exact.totalTime*100:0;return{exact,approximate,distanceDifference,timeDifference,distanceError,timeError,exactOptimal:approximate.totalTime>=exact.totalTime};};
